source_refs.note: iv. Disinfection: a main subheading of 33.6 Wastewater Treatment, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 256-256.

blocks.text: Sirf filtration se dissolved ions (ghule hue ions) ya microscopic pathogens (bohat chhote jaraseem) nahi hatte, is liye chemical purification (chemicals se safai) zaroori hai. Chlorination jaraseem maarne ka sab se aam tareeqa hai. Doosre tareeqon mein sodium hypochlorite (NaOCl), ozone (O₃) ya kabhi hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) use hota hai. Jab chlorine gas ya sodium hypochlorite pani mein dali jati hai to hypochlorous acid (HOCl) banta hai; yeh bacteria aur viruses ki cell wall ke andar ghus kar un ke cell ka kaam bigar deta hai.
